admission.justification: The shared provider policy supplies both ordinary and explainer creation paths, and the ordinary launch receipt reports the applied names. Mounted-server tests compare each advertised surface with its grant. Create-payload tests assert the exact grant and server throughout the role launch routes.

applicability: New Paseo ordinary role seats and bound review-explainer seats for the exact provider ID codex.
conditions: The ordinary launch supplies the task-server definition when the provider accepts MCP definitions.
The bound explainer uses the public roster and its four additional advertised tools on the same server.
The grant and enabled roster of the bound task server come from the build that creates the seat. Paseo keeps that grant on resume and reload.
exclusions: Grants for other provider IDs, including a provider derived from Codex.
A seat running before this change or created from an earlier saved launch payload.
Tools added after creation until the seat is replaced.
Shell commands and calls to a different MCP server.

evidence: BUG-R31-W3-freeze.md and the F07 full launch-payload comparison in the W2 controls archive.

statement: A new Codex seat receives per-tool approval for every tool its starting build offers on its own task server.
